_comment: WO-2 done-criterion 3 (2026-10-05 build brief). PREPARED, NOT RUN: held until
the owner confirms the archive and the data are on the machine and approves runs.
Inference only: no training, no new artifact, the pinned archive is read and
never rewritten. Two commands, because the packaged PyTorch encoder needed for
the list comparison may exist only under tests/ (rule D7).

artifact.stored_layout: torch-packaged-encoder-v1 (no encoder_impl field; converted in memory on load)

acceptance.warm_recall_at_500: equal to the reference when both are rounded to 4 decimals
acceptance.cold_recall_at_500: exactly equal (cold users are popularity-routed and never reach the encoder)
report: the exact warm and cold differences from the reference
how many users' top-500 lists changed (membership vs order only), all users and warm users
acceptance.on_failure: the record is written first, then the run raises; stop and report to the owner

preconditions: the archive above exists locally with the stated SHA-256 (load_sasrec verifies it)
the DVC-pinned cold-start cohort parquet is present (the runner checks before loading data)
ratings come from the dev Postgres or from TWOTOWER_INPUT_DIR (CSV snapshot); either must reproduce the protocol hash, which the runner checks
no other src.training process is running

outputs.record: an MLflow run tagged sweep_label=wo2-converter-reevaluation, reproduction_passed, top500_lists_sha256; evidence under artifacts/sasrec/fastpath-reevaluation/<run-id>/ (retrieval-summary.json with the verdict, per-user-recall.json, top500-lists.json)
